g.text: DETERMINISTIC SPINE: rules over recorded evidence govern claims produced through either reasoning tier.
WHICH CAPABILITIES REALISE, CONSTRAIN AND GRADE EACH TIER

text.tspan: Governed release (C-G4.8)
The service classifies the answer surface, consumes the required verdicts and
saves the release or refusal record. Both reasoning tiers use this service.
Learning from use (C-G7.5)
The system records feedback with its source. Approved changes update the corpus
or become specialist tuning targets after evaluation.
Cross-user promotion boundary (C-G5.7)
consented, de-identified aggregate signal
Legend. The dark band shows shared truth controls. Diamonds show routing decisions. Green shows the corpus, specialist models and learning from use.
Sand shows capabilities that govern or grade a tier. A red rule marks a control point. Blue dashed edges show the feedback path.
Every capability declares
a determinism class
A departure from
deterministic-claim is
justified in its contract
A model gate counts as a gate
only once calibrated
against human labels
Model output crossing back in
passes a vocabulary or
schema check first
Channel
the acting user, or a calling service
Intent routing (C-G2.4)
selects the governed evidence surfaces for the request
recall · observations · live federation · consolidated insight · governed ad-hoc read
Evidence assembly (C-G2.1 · C-G2.2 · C-G2.3)
recall returns evidence; observations reveal deterministic structure over it;
composition fills budgeted slots by rule
Reasoning routing (C-X1)
selects a reasoning tier after evidence assembly
General orchestrator
handles novel and broad tasks through a replaceable interface
Specialist inventory (C-X2)
registered models use defined corpus slices for recurring tasks. Each model
has a cost, quality and latency gate.
Durable-execution substrate (C-X3)
a multi-step reasoning act is a task-keyed journal, so it survives process loss,
resumes at the point it reached, and can be audited afterwards
Proprietary corpus and evaluation substrate
what specialists are grown from, and the sets that decide whether one is good
enough to serve
G7 · Value and Feedback
explain to the acting user, instrument adoption, calibrate reliance,
measure decision quality, close the loop
G2 · Retrieval, Understanding and Answer Composition
the governed evidence surfaces intent routing chooses between
G3 · Trust and Provenance
resolve source of truth, govern claim admission, bind provenance and
propagate lineage, master enterprise entities
G4 · Security and Access · G5 · Governance and Compliance
access, egress, query policy, lawful basis, oversight, erasure
G6 · Runtime and Operations
service levels, detection, degradation, recovery, observability, isolation
G1 · Source Reach, Knowledge Ingress and Lifecycle
reach the estate, capture, keep fresh, sweep contradiction, conform, curate
Grading the tiers
C-X2 eval cards · C-G5.5 model validation · C-G6.4 drift · C-G7.1 decision quality
Bounding the tiers
C-G6.7 unit cost and budget · C-G6.8 latency · C-G6.9 caching

g.text: SPINE CONTROL · evaluated and approved promotion
the answer, and the record of the decision
every interaction, captured with its provenance
promoted into the corpus under gate
and into the inventory, as a tuning target
